title: Scendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation via Schur Complement of CLIP Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the diversity of gender representation in images generated from underspecified professional prompts (e.g., 'a doctor') using the proposed Scendi score to detect representation collapse and implicit model bias.

Evaluating the diversity of age groups (e.g., 'junior' vs. 'senior') represented in generated images of professionals when age details are omitted from the text prompts, calculating the variation using the Scendi metric.
